images.title: Stadium, park and fairground as shared-resource neighborhoods
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a high-fidelity Board DESIGN COMPARISON SHEET, 16:9 landscape. The reference supplies the calm ivory architectural map style, restrained teal, R17 identity and two Table wings. This is three ALTERNATIVE ARRANGEMENTS of the SAME resource neighborhood, not three resources on one map.
Top title "Shared places"; subtitle "R17 · 2 Tables · 2,000 disclosed process associations"; small "Concept · synthetic data". Beneath it, three equally sized large panels with generous gutters labeled "Stadium", "Park", "Fairground". Each panel shows exactly ONE selected central R17 resource plot with two modest hard-edged Table wings T1 and T2, plus FIVE surrounding process-group summary marks OUTSIDE that plot. There are no individual 2,000 process dots or association lines.
The R17 plot and byte-bearing core are the resource. The surrounding five soft/flat cohort forms are participating PROCESS GROUPS, not additional resources, Table rooms, or owned children.
Stadium: place the five cohort summaries as five broken rounded sectors in a broad ring around R17, suggesting seating. Keep them shallow at ground level; no below-ground bowl or process outbox well. Put a quiet letter A through E once on the five sectors. No numbered seats.
Park: arrange the same five cohorts as spaced soft islands around the same R17 core with broad open paths. No literal grass, trees or pools: the park character comes from open space and distributed groups. Label A through E.
Fairground: arrange the same five cohorts as separated rounded stalls/cells in a loose plaza around the R17 core. They remain soft flat process-group marks, distinct from the two architectural Table wings. No rides, tents, people or new resource buildings. Label A through E.
Below all three panels one shared compact line: "A 600 · B 500 · C 400 · D 300 · E 200 unique PIDs". Below that: "Same membership · Different layout". Then a subtle legend: "R17 = resource core   A–E = process groups". Cohort size/height and the illustrated seating are NOT literal counts; the numeric line gives counts. Layout is schematic, not storage capacity or physical geography.
At the bottom, a small neutral note "Recorded associations do not establish active use". No health scores, live user counts, traffic arrows, busy colors or byte-height legend. This is a qualitative participation layout study, not a measurement of building height. Keep all text clean and legible and the architecture understated.

images.title: Observed history and a conditional growth envelope
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a spacious high-fidelity Board resource GROWTH VIEW using the reference's ivory map material, slim header, dark teal selection, R17 two-wing resource architecture and minimal controls. Landscape 16:9 desktop.
Keep header Board, breadcrumb "Atlas / A.01 / R17", search field, and Canvas selected / Browse unselected.
One selected R17 plot occupies the center-left map. Keep two connected Table wings T1/T2 on a stable footprint. Show CURRENT size as solid ivory architecture with a nearby label "Now · 32 MiB". Resource height uses a compressed CURRENT VALUE BYTE scale; the footprint does not expand. Remove other resources and process association paths for this focused time view.
On the SAME building footprint, show two thin solid horizontal historical outline levels INSIDE the current building, quietly labeled "−30d · 16 MiB" and "−7d · 28 MiB". These are synthetic observed size samples, not physical floors. Never put history below ground, where outbox depth already has meaning.
ABOVE the current solid roof, draw a translucent pale blue-grey wireframe extension with clearly DASHED edges. Its middle cap is labeled "+1y · 397 MiB". Two finer dashed outer caps identify a broad SCENARIO ENVELOPE: lower "214.5 MiB", upper "762 MiB". Do not call this a confidence interval or predicted outcome. It represents explicit alternative net-growth assumptions of 0.5, 1 and 2 MiB/day, over 365 elapsed days. Keep the compressed height modest enough to fit comfortably. One faint horizontal reference mark at 256 MiB says "Planning budget · 256 MiB", not quota or physical disk capacity.
At top right ONE compact card: title "Growth scenario"; rows "Start 32 MiB", "Net change +1 MiB/day", "Horizon 365 days", "Scenario size 397 MiB"; beneath, a quiet line "Range: 0.5–2 MiB/day cases". No confidence percentage, green health badge or claim of a measured forecast. Bottom of card one link "Inspect readiness".
A single wide low TIME STRIP near the bottom has seven clearly spaced choices "Past", "Now", "+1d", "+1w", "+1mo", "+1y", "+10y"; +1y is selected. Below the strip one small sentence "Scenario, not a forecast · Month = 30d · Year = 365d". This strip is the only horizon control; no extra timeline chart.
Bottom-left compact legend "Current value bytes" with keys "Solid: observed" and "Dashed: scenario". Bottom-right zoom/reset/Evidence buttons. Footer "Concept · synthetic data".
No stars, ghost people, growing footprint, underground history, amber age color, roads, side navigation or unrelated charts. Clearly distinguish current observed mass, past observed marks, and conditional future wireframe. This is illustrative geometry, not a calibrated statistical chart.

refinements.prompt:
Edit only the grey "Planning budget · 256 MiB" annotation and its horizontal reference guide in this Board growth screenshot. Its current vertical placement is mathematically wrong.
Move that label, grey point and ENTIRE corresponding budget guide UPWARD so the 256 MiB level is clearly ABOVE the 214.5 MiB scenario level and BELOW the 397 MiB scenario level. On the screen this means the grey 256 MiB label/point should lie vertically between the blue "214.5 MiB" label/point and the blue "+1y · 397 MiB" label/point. Position it roughly one third of the way from 214.5 toward 397. The guide must intersect the wireframe envelope at that same intermediate level. Erase its old lower guide and label completely; there is only ONE budget annotation.
Do not change ANY other text, number, building, timeline control, card, selection, background, observed levels or scenario envelope. Preserve the high-fidelity image exactly apart from fixing this budget-marker ordering.

images.title: Readiness as separate constraints, not a health score
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Edit the Board growth view into a spacious BROWSE assessment for the SAME selected Resource R17 and SAME synthetic growth scenario. Keep the exact Board header and breadcrumb "Atlas / A.01 / R17"; Browse is selected and Canvas unselected. Preserve calm ivory/slate/teal typography. High fidelity 16:9 desktop.
Replace the 3D map, height legend and zoom controls with a wide clear assessment page. At top-left below header put "Growth readiness". Small text beside it: "R17 · Synthetic planning case". Under it a concise line "Current values 32 MiB · Steady case +1 MiB/day". No overall green, amber or red health score.
Keep one compact horizon control across the top area with choices "Now", "+1d", "+1w", "+1mo", "+1y", "+10y"; +1y selected. A small label "365 elapsed days".
Main content: a roomy four-row comparison table with headers "Dimension", "Evidence or assumption", "At +1 year", "Assessment".
Row 1: "Current-value budget" | "Planning limit 256 MiB" | "397 MiB steady case" | "Beyond planning limit".
Row 2: "Write contention" | "Activity not measured" | "Not modeled" | "Unknown".
Row 3: "Query performance" | "No scale qualification" | "Not modeled" | "Unknown".
Row 4: "Recovery" | "No scale qualification" | "Not modeled" | "Unknown".
Use neutral outlined textual badges; no false success color or warning icon masquerading as live operational status.
Below the table place ONE restrained horizontal callout: "Planning limit reached in 224 days at +1 MiB/day". A smaller second line: "112–448 days across the illustrated 2–0.5 MiB/day cases". This is conditional planning arithmetic, not a forecast or enforced quota.
At lower-left a small contextual note: "2,000 disclosed process associations · active use unknown". Below that: "Associations do not measure readers, throughput or writer capacity."
At lower-right retain one Evidence button and an "Edit assumptions" button. Do not add an Apply, Scale, Delete, Compact, Retain or Deploy action: this interface is for inspection and planning only.
Footer "Concept · synthetic data". Keep ample whitespace. No duplicate summary cards, resource-volume chart, real SLA, physical-storage quota, recovery-duration claim or arbitrary app data. All exact text must remain readable. The point is that one known planning constraint can be exceeded while other readiness dimensions remain genuinely unmeasured.
